title: Dose-Aware Cold Diffusion with Physics Consistency for Generalizable Low-Dose CT Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2609.18943v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reducing radiation dose in computed tomography significantly degrades image quality and poses challenges for accurate and clinically reliable reconstruction. While recent approaches have shown promise for low-dose CT, they often struggle to generalize across continuous and previously unseen dose levels, leading to artifacts and loss of anatomical detail. To address these limitations, we propose Dose-Aware Cold Diffusion (DACD), a physics-consistent reconstruction framework that explicitly models radiation dose as a continuous latent factor within a cold diffusion process. The proposed DACD framework integrates image-based dose-aware perception, multi-scale structural prior extraction, and dose-calibrated step allocation to adaptively guide the denoising trajectory. translated_title: 面向可泛化低剂量CT重建的物理一致性剂量感知冷扩散
translated_abstract: 降低计算机断层扫描（CT）的辐射剂量会显著降低图像质量，并为实现准确且临床可靠的重建带来挑战。尽管近期的低剂量CT方法展现出了潜力，但它们往往难以在连续且未曾见过的剂量水平上泛化，导致产生伪影和解剖细节丢失。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了剂量感知冷扩散（DACD），这是一种物理一致的重建框架，将辐射剂量显式建模为冷扩散过程中的连续潜在因子。所提出的DACD框架集成了基于图像的剂量感知模块、多尺度结构先验提取以及剂量校准的步骤分配，以自适应地引导去噪轨迹。此外，在反向细化过程中融入了迭代的正反投影校正，以强制执行投影域的数据一致性。大量实验……
tldr: 提出了剂量感知冷扩散框架DACD，通过将辐射剂量建模为冷扩散过程中的连续潜在因子，并结合投影域物理一致性校正，实现了对连续且未见剂量水平的可泛化低剂量CT重建。
